claim: Opens four sample controls without changing a real page
sandbox: fresh browser context; click Try it with sample data; assert the isolated ?demo=1 URL, banner, four sample controls, and seeded result

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: fresh browser context; run a demo command; assert same-origin requests and only demo-prefixed storage

claim: Sample changes use separate browser storage and do not change extension settings
sandbox: fresh browser context with real-setting sentinels; run and reset sample actions; assert real sentinels remain unchanged

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit demo, wait for service worker, set offline, and reload demo

claim: The extension scans only the current page after you open it
sandbox: production extension package; assert activeTab permission and no declarative content script or all-site host permission

claim: Spoken commands run only when speech processing is available on this device
sandbox: production extension popup; stub recognition without processLocally and assert the unavailable status

claim: You can type a visible control name when speech is unavailable
sandbox: production extension popup on a fixture page; type a command and assert the named control runs

claim: Submitting, deleting, publishing, sending, paying, canceling subscriptions, unsubscribing, archiving, deactivating, closing accounts, and signing out require review whose confirmation names the control
where: landing steps, Privacy, README, extension review dialog
sandbox: fixture controls plus the packaged popup; assert every documented label cannot fire before review, the confirmation button names that control, and each fires only after confirmation

claim: Undo restores a locally removed page item when the page allows it
sandbox: browser page where Delete saved draft removes its containing list item; activate after review then undo and assert complete item returns

claim: The extension lists visible buttons, links, and labelled fields on the current page
sandbox: browser page with a visible button, link, labelled select, and hidden button; collect the three visible labels

where: landing limits, README, Privacy, extension footer
sandbox: browser page with a password field and a normal button; collect actions and assert Password is absent

claim: Speech starts only while you hold the speak control
sandbox: production extension popup; stub recognizer and assert pointer, Space, and Enter start on press and stop on release

claim: A $12 one-time Pro license adds saved command names
sandbox: production extension storage with recorded valid verification; save a name, invoke it against sample actions, and assert browser-local storage plus $12 checkout contract

claim: Core page actions and safety checks are free
sandbox: production extension logic with empty extension storage; scan a fixture, use a normal action, and reach review for a sensitive action

claim: The extension does not send page labels, spoken commands, or browsing history
sandbox: complete packaged-extension flow with recorded requests; scan, type, speak, review, undo, and assert no external request

claim: Saved command names and license data are stored in browser-local extension storage; the website does not store license tokens
where: Privacy, public checkout return, extension popup
sandbox: controlled fresh website context with checkout token plus production extension popup; assert no token in website local, session, cookie, IndexedDB, or Cache Storage, then assert extension-local keys and empty sync storage

claim: When you restore Pro, the extension sends the license token to Sociobot for verification
sandbox: production extension popup; restore with a recorded verify response and assert the only external request is encoded Sociobot verification

claim: The extension package is for desktop Chrome and Chromium; mobile browsers can run the demo but cannot install it
sandbox: fresh mobile-sized site plus a clean persistent Chromium profile; assert the mobile disclosure, installation steps, MV3 package, popup title, and first screen
